'''Peyton Swole''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Director of Galactic Relations]] for [[The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Agent [[Dhal]] assumed Swole's identity as part of a sting to capture the [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion]] of the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]], who had [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kellian Jarro]] and destroyed the Republic cruiser [[Aurora (Valor-class)|''Aurora'']].
